page_title: RAY 2-1 CEL | Rayo Vallecano v Celta Vigo 10/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+8' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
90+4' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
90+4' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
90+1' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jorge de Frutos leaves the pitch and Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
86' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Adrian Embarba and he is replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
84' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee blows his whistle, Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.

83' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Dani Cardenas shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
81' Here comes a substitution. Franco Cervi is given a rest as he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) is replacing Carl Starfelt.
81' Here is a change. Fran Beltran is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo).
80' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
80' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
77' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
75' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Isi Palazon.
69' Substitution. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) on for Jonathan Bamba.
69' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
67' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). Guillermo Cuadra saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
65' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Pathe Ciss will be replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Substitution. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) has come on for Sergio Camello.
63' 2 - 1 Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
61' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
58' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) offside.
57' Problems for Claudio Giraldez as Alfonso Gonzalez is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) replaces him.
57' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
55' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
53' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Dani Cardenas is equal to it and makes an easy save.

52' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.

51' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Rayo Vallecano will take a free kick near the side line.
47' The attendance is 12955.
46' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) trips an opposition player and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
45' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
42' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Rayo Vallecano.
37' This is a yellow card! Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
34' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) makes a strong challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a free kick.
33' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
33' The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
32' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity.

31' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
31' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
30' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) jumps into a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
27' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Jonathan Bamba sets up Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
26' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Guillermo Cuadra signals.
25' Rough tackle by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
19' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' The ball is cleared after Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

15' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Vicente Guaita pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
12' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
11' The referee blows his whistle as Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in his challenge.

10' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
8' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
3' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) hacks down one of his opponents.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra is introduced as the referee for today's match.
